text:
**My pick for most people: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim), $54.99**
- It's 0.34" thick and 4.3 oz, with Qi2-certified 15W wireless charging. Anker's page markets it as best for the iPhone 17 series.
- 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery and says it feels premium and runs cooler than competitors.
- Capacity is 5,000mAh, which Macworld says typically gets you about 60-75% of a phone charge.
- Buy: https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank

**If you want more capacity and still want it slim: INIU SnapGo Air 10,000mAh, about $43-49**
- It's about 0.5" thick and 195g, with 25W Qi2.2 wireless, which the iPhone 17 supports, and 45W wired charging.
- It includes a lanyard-style 60W USB-C cable and an LED display.
- Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K MagSafe pack. Android Central praises its value.
- Prices and buy links: https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge

**If you want the absolute thinnest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5,000mAh), about $53-70**
- It's about 0.27" thick and 104g, which Android Central calls the thinnest and lightest it tested.
- The catch is that Android Central lists its wireless speed at just 7.5W, compared with 15W for the Anker. I'd only choose it if thinness matters more than charging speed.
- Buy links: https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge

**Another 10K option: Baseus PicoGo AM52, $53.99 with code AM52**
- It has 25W Qi2.2 wireless and 45W wired charging. The source doesn't list its thickness, so I can't confirm it's slim.
- The listing is an affiliate deal page, and the code was tested in Baseus's cart on Oct 24.
- Link: https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w

**Quick guide**
- **Thinnest and lightest in your pocket:** Anker Nano 5K.
- **A full charge or more, still fairly slim:** INIU SnapGo Air.
- **Cases:** Qi2 banks need a magnetic case. Anker notes that cases thicker than about 2.5 mm, or metal attachments like pop grips, can interfere with charging.
